requests.prompt:
Create a new production combat sprite atlas for the existing French fan RPG Mass Effect — Relay Chronicles. Use the provided crew-atlas.png ONLY as an identity and outfit reference. The target is TALI, the fully helmeted purple-hooded adult QUARIAN WOMAN in the BOTTOM ROW SECOND cell of the reference (column 2, row 2, source rectangle x384–768/y512–1024). Do not include the other seven characters. Preserve this exact existing prototype identity, slender adult proportions, sealed purple opaque-visored respirator helmet, curved hose fittings, patterned purple ME1 hood and divided fabric drape, black sealed environmental suit, silver/gray armor pieces and quarian digitigrade legs/boots. Keep the complete sealed suit and gloves in EVERY pose. NEVER reveal a human face, bare skin or hair; the opaque/tinted helmet covers the entire head. Preserve recognizable quarian anatomy including three-fingered gloves when visible. This is Tali nar Rayya's first-game appearance as represented in the supplied sprite, not an unhelmeted fan portrait or a later-game costume.
Use the same realistic detailed prerendered 3D sprite style, adult anatomy, fine fabric/metal material detail, soft upper-left lighting and clean silhouette as the provided prototype.
Output ONE landscape 1536×1024 PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the figures. Exactly FOUR full-body poses of this SAME Tali, separated into a TWO-COLUMN by TWO-ROW layout with generous wholly transparent gutters and outside margins. No labels, text, cell lines, frame borders, scenery, floor, shadows on a floor plane, background, checkerboard, glow, electricity, hologram or baked VFX. Each upright pose uses the same body scale and fixed elevated orthographic front three-quarter game camera, facing screen right. No chibi, pixel art, anime, poster or portrait treatment. No clipped helmet, hood, hands, weapon or boots.
TOP LEFT — AIM: Tali stands with quarian knees naturally bent, braced and aiming a compact generic science-fiction SHOTGUN toward screen right with both hands. Her complete boots and the complete weapon are visible. Keep purple hood, opaque visor and sealed suit identical to the reference.
TOP RIGHT — POWER: same Tali and camera, one gloved hand reaching forward toward screen right in a technical activation gesture, the other hand nearer her body. NO gun in this pose and NO orange omni-tool, light or hologram drawn onto the figure; the engine adds ability effects separately. The pose is a generic technical command, never a claim of biotic ability.
BOTTOM LEFT — HIT: the same Tali recoils from a harmless impact, torso leaning back slightly and knees flexed, an arm bracing the torso, complete helmet/hood/boots inside the cell. No blood, wounds or projectile. Never remove or break the visor or environmental suit.
BOTTOM RIGHT — DOWN: the same fully helmeted and completely suited Tali lies unconscious horizontally at ground level, head and hood at the LEFT, boots at the RIGHT, arms resting alongside the torso. The full natural-length quarian body fits entirely inside the bottom-right cell with generous transparent padding. It is a low prone/resting silhouette, not kneeling or floating. Keep her face covered and suit intact.
Every cell is a crisp natural cutout: empty areas truly alpha-zero, no diffuse purple/gray halo, fog or ambient vignette. Preserve only natural antialiasing on the actual figure edges.

notes: Sortie native copiée octet pour octet ; aucun pixel modifié par script, aucun outil de détourage ou redimensionnement externe.
La disposition réellement obtenue est mesurée ; la grille régulière demandée ne sert pas directement de preuve de cadrage.
La source visuelle est un prototype préexistant, pas une validation primaire du costume ou de la géométrie originaux.
Quatre poses fixes supplémentaires ; aucun cycle animé, son, statistique ou kit complet original certifié.
